_comment: Sample/seed CVE data for lab use only. Each entry maps an exact product+version to a REAL published CVE. Real deployments would pull this from the NVD API; this offline seed keeps scans deterministic and testable.

entries.title: OpenSSH username enumeration
entries.description: OpenSSH through 7.7 allows remote attackers to enumerate valid usernames by timing the response to malformed authentication requests.

entries.title: nginx DNS resolver off-by-one heap write
entries.description: A security issue in nginx resolver (< 1.21.0) could allow an attacker to overwrite heap memory via a crafted DNS response, potentially leading to remote code execution.

entries.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor command execution
entries.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 shipped with a malicious backdoor that opens a shell on port 6200 when a username containing ':)' is supplied.

entries.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal and RCE
entries.description: A path traversal flaw in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 can map URLs to files outside the document root and, with mod_cgi enabled, lead to remote code execution.
